rows.text:
Initial 3 Vill:
1st Vill and Pharoah goes out and builds a Dock.
2nd and 3rd Vills go to wood and builds a Lumber Camp.
rows.note:
Dock auto-queues Fishing Ships.

(General rule of thumb considering FS:
- 9 FS in archaic
- 12 FS in advance, if there is no pressure
- Classical: 9-12 FS if you fight classical water
- Classical: 18-21 FS if you want to boom)

Pharoah and Villager near Dock go to 2nd Fish location
and build 2nd Dock, after that: Vill makes Houses, Pharaoh back to TC
At 150 Gold build a Temple with 2 of the Gold Villagers,then back to Gold.

rows.text:
Vill disttribution:
- 3 Food to Wood
- 3 Food vto Gold
Continue balancing your economy with reaching Heroic in mind.
rows.note:
Continue building Docks and Fishing Ships on available fish sites.
Build an Armory and Market.
Build a 2nd Monument.
Build Barracks with Spearmen+Anubite+Animals to scout the map and raid.
Build more Barracks to produce an army.
